positive.prompt: Convert this .NET solution to use NuGet Central Package Management
Our NuGet versions are drifting across projects, help us align them with CPM

negative.prompt: Install a preview version of the .NET SDK
Write an API endpoint in minimal APIs

evals.prompt: Migrate the projects under src/ to NuGet Central Package Management with a Directory.Packages.props at the repository root.
evals.expected_output: Directory.Packages.props file is created at the solution root with central package management enabled.
expectations: A baseline build and package list are captured before any project file is changed
The Newtonsoft.Json version conflict (13.0.3 vs 12.0.3) is surfaced to the user with resolution options instead of being silently resolved
Directory.Packages.props is created at the root with ManagePackageVersionsCentrally set to true and a PackageVersion per package
Version attributes are removed from the PackageReference items, and the $(SerilogVersion) property is handled deliberately (inlined or kept with import order considered)
